frozen_rule: target must have no prior project label access or target-specific performance inspection
target primary chromosomes must cover at least 0.95 of assembly bases
target must have chromosome-scale genome GFF3 and protein FASTA with deterministic exact aliases
lineage-specific WGD must be supported independently of candidate references
exactly two candidate references and two evaluator-only references must be available with no species overlap
among eligible systems select smallest target assembly; never use pair yield candidate count or model performance
primary failure cannot be replaced by another eligible species under v0.4
